lesson.title: 5.2 A little rice, a lot of pasta
lesson.unit_outcome: Say how much and how many, offer and order food and drinks politely, agree about likes, say what you want and need to do, talk about meals, prices and what is in your food, compare prices, use numbers to ninety-nine and ask for things at the table.
lesson.lesson_title: A little rice, a lot of pasta
lesson.sub_lesson_title: A little rice, a lot of pasta
lesson.goal: Say how much food there is with a lot of and a little (There's a lot of pasta. / There's a little rice.), and tell a little from 5.1's a few.
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 5.2 Food: A1 names food (bread, rice, chicken, fish) and says who eats or cooks it; A1+ 5.2 says how much of a food there is. A food you do not count takes there's and a little, not a few, and no plural (There's a little rice. / There are a few lemons.); a lot of fits both (There's a lot of pasta.). pasta and butter are the new foods (butter added 2026-11-23). The photos show a big heap against one small spoonful of the same food.
lesson.prerequisite: A1+ 5.1 a lot of and a few; A1 5.2 rice; A1+ 2.4 contractions (there's); A1+ 1.2 eats.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say a little as one phrase (a-LIT-tle, a very short); keep there's short; do not require native-like speed.
